limitations: Vote submission traffic is varied by the workload control; result-query traffic uses the question's NFR-02 target.
Poll API capacity is shared by vote submissions and result queries and is checked against their combined load.
Queue arrivalRatePerSecond is a configured workload value, not a capacity; publishCapacityPerSecond and processingCapacityPerSecond are checked separately.
Queue, database and worker capacities assume steady-state traffic and do not model backlog growth or burst absorption.
Counter-store load includes one aggregation update per vote and one operation per result query.
Counter-store outage marks counter operations unavailable; recovery and stale-result duration are not simulated.
All values are deterministic estimates based on configured capacities, not production measurements.
